verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS communication platform like Discord, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any user- or server-level control over data region or residency. The docs cover APIs, SDKs, Nitro and threads, and community items address unrelated topics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
